c: A political prisoner walks free after 27 years.
A space telescope launches — with a blurry mirror.
East and West Germany become one country again.
h: The very start of the decade.
e: 1990 — Mandela released (Feb), Hubble launched (Apr), German reunification (Oct).

c: The USSR ceases to exist on Boxing Day.
A Philippine volcano erupts and cools the whole planet.
Operation Desert Storm.
e: 1991 — Gulf War (Desert Storm), Pinatubo erupted, the Soviet Union dissolved.

c: NBA stars play at the Olympics for the first time in Barcelona.
'Euro Disney' opens near Paris.
A Category 5 hurricane flattens southern Florida.
The Queen calls it her 'annus horribilis'.
e: 1992 — the Dream Team at Barcelona, Euro Disney opened, Hurricane Andrew.

c: A famous handshake on the White House lawn.
A truck bomb explodes under the World Trade Center.
A 51-day standoff in Texas.
Dinosaurs come back to life in a Spielberg blockbuster.
e: 1993 — the Oslo Accords handshake, first WTC bombing, Waco siege, Jurassic Park.

c: A tunnel under the sea links England and France.
A former prisoner becomes South Africa's president.
Sony's first games console launches in Japan.
Brazil win the World Cup in the USA.
e: 1994 — Channel Tunnel opened, Mandela became president, PlayStation launched, USA '94.

c: Mandela, in a Springbok jersey, hands over the Rugby World Cup.
A truck bomb destroys a federal building in Oklahoma.
An online auction site is founded.
Microsoft launches Windows with a 'Start' button.
e: 1995 — the Rugby World Cup in South Africa, Oklahoma City bombing, eBay founded, Windows 95.

c: The first mammal cloned from an adult cell is born.
A chess computer beats the world champion in a game.
Atlanta hosts the Centennial Olympics.
e: 1996 — Dolly the sheep, Deep Blue beat Kasparov in a game, the Atlanta Olympics.

c: 'I'll tell you what I want, what I really really want…'
A console with a 3-pronged controller launches.
'Football's coming home' — England host the Euros.
e: 1996 — Wannabe, the Nintendo 64, Euro 96 in England.

c: Britain hands Hong Kong back to China.
A small rover trundles across Mars.
A 21-year-old wins the Masters by 12 strokes.
A princess dies in a car crash in Paris.
e: 1997 — Hong Kong handover, Mars Pathfinder, Tiger's first Masters, Diana's death.

c: The first module of the International Space Station launches.
France win the World Cup at home.
Two Stanford students found a search company in a garage.
The Good Friday Agreement is signed.
e: 1998 — Zarya launched, France won the World Cup, Google founded, the Good Friday Agreement.

c: A sail-shaped hotel opens in Dubai.
A total solar eclipse crosses Europe.
Everyone worries about the Y2K bug.
The euro launches as a currency.
e: 1999 — Burj Al Arab opened, the European eclipse, the euro, Y2K, and Putin became acting president.

c: An Aboriginal sprinter lights the cauldron and wins 400 m gold in Sydney.
The first crew moves into the International Space Station.
A giant dome opens in London to mark the new millennium.
e: 2000 — Sydney Olympics, Expedition 1 on the ISS, the Millennium Dome.

c: A Concorde crashes after take-off from Paris.
A console that doubled as a DVD player launches.
Fireworks over a harbour bridge open a new millennium of Olympics.
e: 2000 — the Concorde crash, PlayStation 2 launched, the Sydney Olympics.

c: Hijacked planes hit the Twin Towers.
The first paying space tourist visits the ISS.
A Russian space station is brought down into the Pacific.
Apple launches the iPod; Wikipedia goes live.
e: 2001 — 9/11, Dennis Tito, Mir deorbited, the iPod and Wikipedia.

c: Twelve countries start paying with new notes and coins.
Brazil win the first World Cup held in Asia.
The Queen celebrates 50 years on the throne.
e: 2002 — euro notes and coins circulate, Brazil win in Japan/Korea, the Golden Jubilee.

c: Supersonic airliners make their last commercial flights.
A space shuttle breaks up on re-entry.
A dictator's statue is pulled down in Baghdad.
The Human Genome Project is completed.
e: 2003 — Concorde retired, Columbia lost, the Iraq War, the human genome completed.

c: A Boxing Day tsunami devastates coasts around the Indian Ocean.
A Harvard student launches a social network.
Twin rovers land on Mars.
The Olympics return to Athens.
e: 2004 — the Indian Ocean tsunami, Facebook, Spirit & Opportunity, Athens 2004.

c: A hurricane floods New Orleans.
The world's largest passenger jet makes its first flight.
'Me at the zoo' is the first video on a new website.
e: 2005 — Hurricane Katrina, the A380's first flight, YouTube.

c: A German cardinal becomes Pope.
Liverpool come back from 3–0 down in Istanbul.
Concerts around the world to 'Make Poverty History'.
e: 2005 — Benedict XVI elected, the Miracle of Istanbul, Live 8.

c: Astronomers decide Pluto is no longer a planet.
A console with a motion-sensing remote launches.
Italy win the World Cup in Germany after a famous headbutt.
The first tweet is sent.
e: 2006 — Pluto demoted, the Wii, Italy won the World Cup (Zidane's headbutt), Twitter.

c: 'An iPod, a phone, and an internet communicator.'
The 'New 7 Wonders of the World' are announced.
The final Harry Potter book is published.
e: 2007 — the iPhone, the New 7 Wonders, Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows.

c: The Olympics open in a 'Bird's Nest' stadium.
A Jamaican sprinter sets world records while celebrating.
A giant investment bank collapses.
e: 2008 — Beijing Olympics, Usain Bolt, Lehman Brothers collapsed.

c: The world's biggest particle collider is switched on.
A swimmer wins 8 golds at one Games.
America elects its first Black president.
e: 2008 — the LHC switched on, Phelps's 8 golds, Obama elected.

c: A pilot lands a jet on the Hudson River.
The King of Pop dies.
A record crowd watches a presidential inauguration.
The first Bitcoin is mined.
e: 2009 — Miracle on the Hudson, Michael Jackson died, Obama inaugurated, Bitcoin.

c: The world's tallest building opens.
An Icelandic volcano grounds flights across Europe.
33 Chilean miners are rescued after 69 days.
Apple launches the iPad.
e: 2010 — Burj Khalifa, Eyjafjallajökull, the Chilean miners, the iPad.

c: Plastic horns drone through a World Cup in Africa.
Spain win their first World Cup.
An oil rig explodes in the Gulf of Mexico.
e: 2010 — the South Africa World Cup, Spain champions, Deepwater Horizon.

c: A royal wedding at Westminster Abbey.
An earthquake and tsunami hit a Japanese nuclear plant.
Protests sweep across the Arab world.
e: 2011 — William & Kate married, Fukushima, the Arab Spring.

c: Officials watch a raid in Pakistan from the White House.
The Space Shuttle flies for the last time.
India win the Cricket World Cup at home with a six.
Steve Jobs dies.
e: 2011 — the bin Laden raid, the last shuttle flight, India won the Cricket World Cup.

c: A car-sized rover lands on Mars using a 'sky crane'.
A skydiver jumps from the edge of space.
London hosts the Olympics for a third time.
e: 2012 — Curiosity landed, Red Bull Stratos, the London Olympics.

c: The Queen celebrates 60 years on the throne.
A 'superstorm' floods New York's subway.
A K-pop video becomes the first to hit 1 billion YouTube views.
e: 2012 — the Diamond Jubilee, Hurricane Sandy, Gangnam Style.

c: The first Pope from the Americas is elected.
A meteor explodes over a Russian city, caught on dashcams.
A British man wins Wimbledon for the first time in 77 years.
e: 2013 — Pope Francis, the Chelyabinsk meteor, Murray's Wimbledon.

c: A contractor leaks secret NSA files.
A future king is born.
A super typhoon devastates the Philippines.
Nelson Mandela dies.
e: 2013 — the Snowden leaks, Prince George born, Typhoon Haiyan, Mandela's death.

c: A probe lands on a comet.
People pour iced water over their heads for charity.
Germany win the World Cup in Brazil (and beat the hosts 7–1).
e: 2014 — Philae, the Ice Bucket Challenge, Germany won in Brazil.

c: A probe sends back the first close-up photos of Pluto.
A huge earthquake strikes Nepal.
Nearly 200 nations sign a climate deal in Paris.
e: 2015 — New Horizons at Pluto, the Nepal earthquake, the Paris Agreement.

c: A rocket booster lands upright back on Earth for the first time.
A famous lion is killed in Zimbabwe.
A midfielder scores a hat-trick in 16 minutes in a Women's World Cup final.
e: 2015 — SpaceX's first booster landing, Cecil the lion, the USA won the Women's World Cup.

c: A probe enters orbit around Jupiter.
5000-1 outsiders Leicester City win the Premier League.
The UK votes to leave the EU.
People chase virtual creatures through the streets on their phones.
e: 2016 — Juno at Jupiter, Leicester champions, the Brexit vote, Pokémon Go, the Rio Olympics.

c: A 'Great American Eclipse' crosses the USA coast to coast.
A hurricane dumps record rain on Houston.
A probe dives into Saturn to end its mission.
e: 2017 — the Great American Eclipse, Hurricane Harvey, Cassini's Grand Finale.

c: A 39-year-old becomes France's youngest president.
Spinning toys take over classrooms.
A Swiss legend wins his 8th Wimbledon.
'Despacito' is the song of the summer.
e: 2017 — Macron elected, fidget spinners, Federer's 8th Wimbledon, Despacito.

c: A boys' football team is rescued from a flooded cave in Thailand.
A rocket sends a red sports car into space.
France win the World Cup in Russia.
Prince Harry marries Meghan Markle.
e: 2018 — the Thai cave rescue, Falcon Heavy's Tesla, France won in Russia, the Harry & Meghan wedding.

c: A cathedral's spire collapses in a fire in Paris.
The first-ever photo of a black hole.
A teenage activist sails across the Atlantic.
e: 2019 — the Notre-Dame fire, the first black hole image, Greta's Atlantic crossing.

c: The USA win a second straight Women's World Cup in France.
England win the Cricket World Cup on a super over.
A new UK prime minister promises to 'Get Brexit Done'.
e: 2019 — the Women's World Cup, England's cricket win, Boris Johnson became PM.

c: The world goes into lockdown.
A private spacecraft takes astronauts to the ISS.
A basketball legend dies in a helicopter crash.
The Tokyo Olympics are postponed.
e: 2020 — COVID-19 lockdowns, SpaceX Demo-2, Kobe Bryant's death.

c: A giant container ship gets stuck in the Suez Canal.
A rover lands on Mars carrying a small helicopter.
Delayed Olympics are held with empty stands.
h: A year late for the Olympics.
e: 2021 — the Ever Given, Perseverance landed, Tokyo 2020 held in 2021.

c: A billionaire rides his own rocket to space.
The first all-civilian crew orbits Earth.
The first powered flight on another planet.
e: 2021 — Bezos on New Shepard, Inspiration4, Ingenuity's first flight on Mars.

c: A new space telescope releases its first deep-field images.
Argentina win the World Cup in Qatar.
Britain's longest-reigning monarch dies.
e: 2022 — JWST's first images, Argentina won in Qatar, Queen Elizabeth II died.

c: NASA crashes a spacecraft into an asteroid on purpose.
A giant new Moon rocket flies an uncrewed capsule around the Moon.
A billionaire buys Twitter.
A chatbot called ChatGPT is released.
e: 2022 — DART, Artemis I, Musk bought Twitter, ChatGPT launched.

c: India lands a spacecraft near the Moon's south pole.
A king is crowned at Westminster Abbey.
A submersible is lost on a dive to the Titanic.
e: 2023 — Chandrayaan-3, Charles III's coronation, the Titan submersible.

c: Huge earthquakes strike Turkey and Syria.
AI chatbots go mainstream.
A record-breaking stadium tour; a pink-and-atomic 'Barbenheimer' summer.
e: 2023 — the Turkey–Syria earthquakes, the AI boom, the Eras Tour and Barbenheimer.

c: A total eclipse crosses Mexico, the USA and Canada.
A container ship knocks down a bridge in Baltimore.
Paris hosts the Olympics, with an opening ceremony on the Seine.
A giant rocket booster is caught by 'chopsticks'.
e: 2024 — the North American eclipse, the Baltimore bridge collapse, the Paris Olympics, Starship's booster catch.

c: The first American Pope is elected.
Wildfires burn through Los Angeles in January.
A president returns for a second, non-consecutive term.
e: 2025 — Pope Leo XIV, the LA wildfires, Trump's second inauguration.

c: A private lander touches down on the Moon.
Liverpool win the Premier League in their new manager's first season.
Thieves steal crown jewels from the world's most-visited museum.
e: 2025 — Blue Ghost landed on the Moon, Liverpool champions, the Louvre jewel heist.

c: Milan and Cortina host the Winter Olympics.
The first 48-team World Cup is played across the USA, Canada and Mexico.
The USA marks its 250th birthday.
e: 2026 — Milano Cortina Winter Olympics, the 48-team World Cup, America's 250th.
